prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of Fuel — the lord of the Fuel House of the Hydrogen Nation. A female character who IS that substance; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the substance’s traits, within the element’s own palette. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Hydrogen (H) to carry in her design and the scene: airy, pale and luminous, always rising: translucent layers, upward-drifting hair and hems, a faint pale-blue flame (hydrogen burns almost invisibly), star-light and fusion white, water droplets and mist; it is the lightest element, the fuel of stars and half of every drop of water. Palette: pale sky blue, white, silver, a faint violet flame, clear glass.
HOUSE TRAITS of Fuel: a nearly invisible pale-blue flame, cryogenic frost on tanks and pipes, valves and pressure lines; clean fire that leaves only water. Palette: pale blue flame, frost white, tank silver, warning orange.
AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin, soft full cheeks; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) and a soft smile that never creases her face.
SILHOUETTE: athletic build; an updo bun; silver-white hair.
FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): heart-shaped face; wide almond eyes; thin arched brows; small button nose; small bow lips; ice-blue eyes.
WORLD — STEAMPUNK: around 1900, an airship harbour: great hydrogen gas envelopes under a mooring mast, brass valves and gauges, an electrolysis laboratory with glass jars and a spectroscope, telegraph wires, dawn haze. COSTUME (steampunk): late-Victorian industrial dress — a high-necked blouse with a waistcoat or a tailored tail coat, leather gloves, a work apron or utility belt with brass fittings, goggles on the brow or a small instrument as ornament; below, a short bustle skirt over riding trousers and laced boots; muted palette with the traits above as accents. No armor plates, no cape, no crown unless CONCEPT says she wears one; steam, pipes and gauges in the scene; no modern plastic, no sci-fi. LIGHT: hazy gaslight and a smoky overcast sky, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise.
SETTING (this card): under a great hydrogen envelope at the airship mooring mast.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): the high collar unbuttoned down to the sternum with natural cleavage, sleeves rolled above the elbow, a short bustle skirt showing the legs above laced boots; the waistcoat stays buttoned at the waist. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
source: 생성기 조립 그대로 — 수소나라 연료 가문주(2026-10-31, 사용자 「연료 가문주 이미지 생성 작업해줘」). 장면 변주로 근본·물·기구 가문주와 배경을 갈랐다(별불 신전 · 비행선 항구 · 토카막)
